title: factdiff.search_urls sends a request to every search_api row and reads only Learn's results key
goal: factdiff.search_urls asks a provider's search_api only for a row whose response shape it reads (provider.search_shape names the shape), or reads the hits through provider.search, so a github, github-blob, pypi or arxiv source whose passage left its page costs no request that cannot yield a candidate page

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import factdiff, inspect; sys.exit(0 if 'search_shape' in inspect.getsource(factdiff.search_urls) else 1)
